fields.summary_ko.0: TSM's board approved up to $500M investment in Anthropic common shares and up to $500M in OpenAI preferred shares, and raised Q3 dividend from NT$7.0 to NT$9.0
fields.summary_ko.1: TSM US-listed shares rose 5% in Wednesday premarket trading, with October revenue up 60% at NT$58.69B (approximately $1.79B), sustaining strong AI chip demand
